# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Please see the repository tags for currently supported releases. We generally support the latest minor release for security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in MirrorRelay, please do NOT report it by opening a public issue.

Instead, please report it via GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature on the repository:
1. Navigate to the "Security" tab of this repository.
2. Click on "Advisories".
3. Click "Report a vulnerability".

We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report and work with you to resolve it.
